messages.subject: Jackknife Slope Index
parts:
Hi Phil,

I'm currently trying to use the JSI method to identify locally dependent items. Where I'm struggling is trying to find the differences between the folded and unfolded matrices. I don't think there are actually any differences between the two.  Do the top half of these matrices comprise folded or unfolded values?

Here is the code I used to create the unfolded matrix:
residuals(englishTNT_imputedGRM_i, method = "JSI", fold = F)

Here is the cod I used to create the folded matrix:
residuals(englishTNT_imputedGRM_i, method = "JSI", fold = T)

I included the two matrices produced by these codes as csv files for review.  Any help will be greatly appreciated.

-Zac

-Zac
